# Pismo Zones

> What time is it for the team? Pismo Zones shows every Pismo office at a glance — local time, working state, daylight, holidays — and converts any moment you type, drag or share. Every calculation runs on your device, it works offline, and it is exact across daylight-saving changes.

Pismo Zones is a web app at https://pismozones.ashwingopalsamy.in/. It needs no account. The source is public under CC0 1.0 Universal.

## Docs

- [Overview (Markdown)](https://pismozones.ashwingopalsamy.in/index.md): what the app does, how to use it, share links and privacy.
- [Full text](https://pismozones.ashwingopalsamy.in/llms-full.txt): the same facts in more detail, in one file.
